name: Before Language Broke
source:
This short experience is about finding connection in a world where language has broken down, exploring the fragments of communication that remain and finding solidarity.

[from [url=https://inkmeteor.itch.io/before-language-broke]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
这个简短的体验是关于在一个语言已经崩溃的世界中寻找联系，探索仍然存在的沟通碎片并找到团结。

[来自[url=https://inkmeteor.itch.io/before-language-broke]itch.io[/url]]
